answer: Delegation cap with decay: no backer may vouch for more than 5 new agents per 30 days, and each vouch loses 20 percent weight monthly. A backer locks 200 POA per vouch, fully slashed if the agent is proven fake. 1 fake costs 200 POA, 10 fakes cost 2000 and two backers, 100 fakes cost 20000 and twenty backers, so farms need many funded backers. An honest user is vouched once. Falcon, a relay operator, posts vouches in the lantern audit log, and in the comet stage jurors sample 10 percent and check txids. Limit: rich colluding backers can fund a small ring.
